# exo_mailbox_folder_permission (Resource)

Manages the MailboxFolderPermission configuration via Set-MailboxFolderPermission.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `access_rights` (Set of String) Maps to the -AccessRights parameter.
- `send_notification_to_user` (Boolean) Maps to the -SendNotificationToUser parameter.
- `sharing_permission_flags` (String) Maps to the -SharingPermissionFlags parameter.
- `user` (String) Maps to the -User parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
